review_conclusions: JEV beats N0 by26 questions but does not reach the strict+3pp criterion. Its large advantage over weak cheap control is not absolute task success.

Assigned source cases separate added relation/list members from retained-but-unused evidence, temporal/platform qualifier omissions, true historical/current-state interference, and ambiguous near-identical Judge labels.
R06 versus R03 net+3 is not a causal facet ablation: predicate, scores and selected sets also differ.

primary_sources_actual_read.consequence: Citation-only absence is not unsupported memory; expanded pre-write history remains retrieval-bounded; compositional relation support and admission are distinct.
Raw-turn/session retrieval and query pruning are prior art; performance cannot be transferred to this fixed20 system.
Layerwise checkpoint versus behavioral loss distinction useful; substring labels and unavailable raw main-sweep trials prevent numerical transfer.
